eastern Conejos County.

River towards their confluence with the Rio Grande, downstream of
Alamosa.

South Central Alamosa County in southeastern Colorado...

Some roads remain closed due to flooding. Expect many areas of slow
moving or standing water.

piers. Heed the advice of lifeguards, beach patrol flags and
signs.

current, relax and float. Don't swim against the current. If
able, swim in a direction following the shoreline. If unable to
escape, face the shore and call or wave for help.
